LANDING.HERO_SUBTITLE: BaronixTZ — Bar Online Management & Supervision — manages and supervises your bar online. Once you join, BaronixTZ takes over the managing: it checks every order, counts the stock, takes the waiters' handovers and sets aside money for costs — and you see it all on your phone, wherever you are.
LANDING.NIGHT_TITLE: The work you'd pay a manager for — BaronixTZ does it
LANDING.STEP1_DESC: Waiters write orders with their own code; the counter or kitchen receives them before anything leaves. Nothing leaves unwritten.
LANDING.STEP2_DESC: Crates come in, bottles go out as sales. A stock count shows what went missing and what it was worth — early, not at month end.
LANDING.STEP3_DESC: Each waiter sees the cash and phone money to hand over; the cashier receives it in one tap. A shortage is recorded against their name.
LANDING.STEP4_DESC: Profit per product, sales by hour and money pots — right away, even when you're out of town.
LANDING.SPLIT_DESC: BaronixTZ sets money aside before it is spent: every sale is split by your percentages — TRA, rent, loan, power and new stock — as a careful manager would.
LANDING.F1_TITLE: Stock by the Crate and the Kilo
LANDING.F1_DESC: Beer is bought by the Crate and sold by the Bottle, Meat is bought by the Kilo and sold as Skewers, Portions or Halves — BaronixTZ knows how much each takes from the Store.
LANDING.F2_DESC: Each Waiter sells with their own Code and PIN; Bills and Commission go to them.
LANDING.F3_DESC: Waiter, Counter, Chef, Cashier, Manager or Owner — each sees only what they need.
LANDING.F4_DESC: Sales, Profit, Handovers and Money Pots — by day, week or month.
LANDING.F5_DESC: Manage all your Bars from one account, each branch with its own stock.
LANDING.CTA_TITLE: Don't ruin your Bar for want of a Supervisor. BaronixTZ is the Solution.
LANDING.CTA_SUBTITLE: Sign in and see how your bar is doing right now.
LANDING.GALLERY_TITLE: You enjoy the business — BaronixTZ keeps the books
LANDING.GALLERY_DESC: Customers see the counter, the grill and the music. Behind it, BaronixTZ watches every bottle, every skewer and every shilling — a manager who never sleeps, and no notebook.
LANDING.G_COUNTER_NOTE: Every drink lands on its table's bill
LANDING.G_BEER_NOTE: Bought by the crate, sold by the bottle
LANDING.G_GRILL_NOTE: One kilo - skewers, portions or halves
LANDING.G_COCKTAILS_NOTE: Every service with its own price
LANDING.G_CROWD_NOTE: Bills stay open until they are paid
LANDING.ABOUT_DESC: BaronixTZ is a system for managing your Bar. You can run everything in your Bar from home, on the road, at the office or at your other business. BaronixTZ records every order, counts the stock, takes the waiters' money and sets aside the cost pots — while you see everything on your phone.
LANDING.ABOUT_P1_T: For the Owner who isn't at the Bar every day
LANDING.ABOUT_P1_D: They see Sales, Stock and Handovers from Home, on the Road or at their other Business.
LANDING.ABOUT_P2_D: Drinks by the Crate and Bottle, Meat by the Kilo and Skewer — built for how a Bar really works.
LANDING.ABOUT_P3_D: Each branch with its own Stock, Staff and Reports, under one account.
LANDING.M1_D: Sales carry on when the internet drops, and are saved when it comes back.
LANDING.M2_D: Cash, M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money, HaloPesa and Bank are accepted.
LANDING.M3_D: Print the bill before paying and the receipt after, on a 58mm printer.
LANDING.M4_D: An order sent reaches the Counter or Kitchen at once: a Bill paid updates every screen.
LANDING.S1_D: Tell us about your bar — branches, products and staff.
LANDING.S2_D: Products, prices, the money split and bill codes are ready for you.
LANDING.S3_D: Each waiter gets a code and PIN; cashier, counter, chef and manager get their own accounts.
LANDING.S4_D: Reports, handovers and stock reach your phone every day.
LANDING.ROLES_TITLE: Everyone sees only their own work
LANDING.R_OWNER_D: Profit, money pots and reports for every branch.
LANDING.R_MANAGER_D: Stock, stock counts, staff and shortages.
LANDING.R_CASHIER_D: Taking payments, waiters' handovers and the shift cash-up.
LANDING.R_SUPERVISOR_D: Receive or reject orders — drinks at the counter, food in the kitchen — before they leave.
LANDING.R_WAITER_D: Their bills, their orders and the money to hand over — on their own phone.
LANDING.PRICE_DESC: Sign up with BaronixTZ now and get a bonus of 30 days Free. After that it's a monthly subscription paid by mobile money — the price depends on the size of your bar and number of branches.
LANDING.PRICE_INC1: All services — orders, stock, handovers and reports
LANDING.PRICE_INC2: Waiters' phones and the counter computer
LANDING.PRICE_INC3: We help you set up your bar
LANDING.PRICE_INC4: Pay with M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa or Airtel Money
LANDING.Q1: What devices does BaronixTZ work on?
LANDING.A1: It works on a Phone, Tablet or Computer. Waiters use their own phones.
LANDING.Q2: If the mobile network goes down, does the Service carry on?
LANDING.A2: Yes, it carries on. The information is kept on your device and saved when the network comes back.
LANDING.A3: A 58mm receipt printer connected to a phone or computer. Receipts can also be shown on screen without printing.
LANDING.Q4: Can a waiter serve a drink without writing it down?
LANDING.A4: Every Order goes through the Counter or Kitchen before it leaves, and stock is counted — anything Missing shows up in the stock variance Report.
LANDING.A5: It is Safe. It is stored on Cloud Servers over an encrypted Connection (HTTPS). Everyone signs in with their own account, and each branch sees only its own data.
LANDING.Q6: Can I manage more than one bar?
LANDING.A6: Yes. Each branch has its own Stock, Staff and Reports; you see them all from one account.
LANDING.A7: By mobile money, monthly, right from inside BaronixTZ.
LANDING.CONTACT_DESC: Write to us so we can tell you more, help you get started or sign your bar up to BaronixTZ.
LANDING.CONTACT_HAVE: Already have an account? Sign in
LANDING.SV_DESC: Everything a careful manager would do in your bar — organised into eight services that work together.
LANDING.ASK1_A: I'm the system that supervises your bar digitally — I look after your orders, stock and money every shift.
LANDING.ASK2_Q: I'm far from my bar! How can you help?
LANDING.ASK2_A: Don't worry. I'll let you have your bar wherever you are — you'll see every order, all the stock and every shilling from home, on the road or at your other business.
LANDING.ASK3_A: I record, check and confirm every order, then bring you the report on orders, stock and shillings.
LANDING.ASK4_Q: My stock runs out without notice! How will I know?
LANDING.ASK4_A: I'll check the stock before and after sales, and tell you whenever a product runs out.
LANDING.ASK5_Q: I need to know the profit and loss on each product! How?
LANDING.ASK5_A: I'll show you the profit and loss on every product, and advise you which ones make you the most money.
LANDING.ASK6_A: Because I'm the prefect, the executive, the coordinator, the adviser and the memory of your bar — all in one.
LANDING.SV1_D: Every shilling that comes in gets its job before it is spent.
LANDING.SV1_B1: Every sale is split into pots — for example Staff, Emergency, Owner, power and more.
LANDING.SV1_B2: Expenses are paid from their pot, recording who paid, when and how.
LANDING.SV2_D: Sales go on with the internet, and even without it.
LANDING.SV2_B1: Every table's or customer's bill is recorded, with the waiter's name.
LANDING.SV2_B2: Payments by cash, M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money, HaloPesa and bank.
LANDING.SV2_B3: Receipts are printed or sent by SMS.
LANDING.SV3_D: No drink or food leaves the counter or kitchen unwritten.
LANDING.SV3_B1: Waiters write orders with their own code, on their own phone.
LANDING.SV3_B2: The counter or chef receives or rejects an order before the drink or food leaves.
LANDING.SV3_B3: Cold or warm goes on the order, so the drink is ready before the waiter reaches the counter.
LANDING.SV4_D: Know the stock in the store, used, missing or spoilt.
LANDING.SV4_B1: Beer bought by the crate, sold by the bottle; meat by the kilo, sold as halves, portions or skewers.
LANDING.SV4_B2: Stock goes down with every sale, with a warning when it runs low.
LANDING.SV4_B3: Stock deliveries recorded with their cost.
LANDING.SV4_B4: A stock count shows what went missing per product and what it was worth.
LANDING.SV5_D: Everyone with their own job, and their own pay.
LANDING.SV5_B1: Each waiter signs in with their own code.
LANDING.SV5_B2: Commission is worked out per product sold, and paid from its own pot.
LANDING.SV5_B3: A handover shortage comes off their commission.
LANDING.SV6_D: Every shift's money counted and matched.
LANDING.SV6_B1: Waiters see the cash and phone money they owe, and send it to the cashier.
LANDING.SV6_B2: The cashier receives all of one payment method's bills in one tap.
LANDING.SV6_B3: Cashier cash-up: expected against counted, for each payment method.
LANDING.SV6_B4: Shifts open and close; payouts from the drawer come off the count.
LANDING.SV7_D: See how the business is doing — by day, week or month.
LANDING.SV7_B1: Profit and margin for every product.
LANDING.SV7_B2: Best sellers, and what sits in the store unsold.
LANDING.SV7_B4: Spending per pot and income per week.
LANDING.SV8_D: All your bars under one control.
LANDING.SV8_B1: Each branch with its own stock, staff and reports.
LANDING.SV8_B2: Someone with several branches picks the branch at sign-in.
LANDING.SV8_B3: Everyone signs in with their own account; each branch sees only its own data.
LANDING.SV8_B4: Anything taken off a bill is recorded with a reason.
LANDING.ASK7_Q: My waiters serve drinks without writing them! What do I do?
LANDING.ASK7_A: Don't worry. Every order goes through me: the counter or kitchen receives or rejects it before anything leaves — nothing goes out for free.
LANDING.ASK8_Q: Waiters' money handovers are a mess every day!
LANDING.ASK8_A: I'll give each waiter the total cash and phone money they owe, and the cashier receives it in one tap.
LANDING.ASK9_Q: If the internet goes down, does the work stop?
LANDING.ASK9_A: No. Sales carry on offline, and I'll save them all when the internet is back.
LANDING.ASK10_Q: How do I start using you?
LANDING.ASK10_A: It's easy: contact us, we set up your bar, your waiters get their codes — and you start with 30 days free.

SETTINGS_PAGE.TITLE: System Settings
SETTINGS_PAGE.PURPOSE_TEXT: The Settings module allows administrators to configure and manage the application's core features, security, users, workflows, and system preferences.
SETTINGS_PAGE.WHAT_YOU_CAN_DO_LIST:
• Manage tenants and organizational information.
• Configure users, roles, and permissions.
• Set up workflows and approval processes.
• Manage notifications and system preferences.
• Configure integrations and other administrative settings.
SETTINGS_PAGE.NOTE_TEXT: Changes made in this section may affect the entire system. Only authorized administrators should modify system settings to ensure security, consistency, and proper application operation.

CONFIGURATION_PAGE.TITLE: System Configuration
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.PURPOSE_TEXT: Configuration Management allows administrators to configure and maintain system-wide settings that control the behavior, security, and operational features of the application.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.WHAT_YOU_CAN_DO_LIST:
• Configure email settings.
• Configure SMS settings.
• Manage notification preferences.
• View and manage audit logs.
• Customize system behavior.
• Save and update configuration settings.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.NOTE_TEXT: Configuration settings affect the entire system. Changes should only be performed by authorized administrators to ensure system stability, security, and consistent operation.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.GENERAL_SUBTITLE: Platform-wide numbers that control billing, sessions and maintenance.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.COMMISSION_RATE_HINT: Share of each subscription payment paid to the staff member who registered the branch. Changing this affects future payments only.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.DIRECTOR_PERCENT_HINT: Share of each month's income due to the director role in total, divided between however many hold it.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.ROOT_PERCENT_HINT: Share of each month's income due to the ROOT role in total, divided between however many hold it.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.TRIAL_DAYS_HINT: How long a newly registered branch can use the system before it must pay.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.GRACE_PERIOD_DAYS_HINT: Extra days a branch can keep logging in after its subscription expires. 0 locks them out immediately.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.MINIMUM_PAYMENT_HINT: Smallest subscription payment that can be collected.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.DEFAULT_PLAN_PRICE_HINT: Pre-filled on every new branch. 0 means no default.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.SESSION_LENGTH_HINT: How long a user stays logged in before signing in again.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.ERROR_RETENTION_HINT: How long an error stays in Settings > Errors.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.ERROR_PURGE_HINT: When cleared errors are removed for good. Must be greater than or equal to the value above.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.LOW_STOCK_LEVEL_HINT: A service with this many packs or fewer left (crates, cartons - or single units, if it has no pack) is shown in red as running low.

DOWNLOAD.TITLE: Get the BaronixTZ app
DOWNLOAD.LEAD: Run your bar from your phone: sales, orders, store, reports, cash-up and receipts - everything on the website, now in an app. Sign in with the same account you use here.
DOWNLOAD.APPLE: The app is for Android phones for now. On an iPhone, keep using this website.
DOWNLOAD.S1_D: Tap Download. The file (APK) goes to your phone's Downloads.
DOWNLOAD.S2_D: When you open it, the phone asks to allow "Install unknown apps" for the browser (Chrome). Allow it - only once.
DOWNLOAD.S3_D: Tap Install. If Play Protect asks, choose "Install anyway" - the app is BaronixTZ's own.
DOWNLOAD.S4_D: Open BaronixTZ and sign in with your username and password, or code and PIN for waiters.
DOWNLOAD.ALL_PHONES: Works on every Android phone, new and old
